input.body:
**PR #2 was merged into `main` without approval from anyone other than its author (2 commits).**

**What I did**
- Branch protection is fine: P1–P6 all **pass** (PR required, 1 approval, stale approvals dismissed, `test` check required, no bypass actors, force-push and deletion blocked). I didn't change anything, so I didn't run verify_repo.
- Opened retro-review issues for both commits. Both were already open:
  - `599d9a1` (merge of PR #2): https://github.com/TheEraptic/grc-lab-payments-api/issues/5
  - `46d465d` (docs: add test instructions to README): https://github.com/TheEraptic/grc-lab-payments-api/issues/6

**What you need to do**
Have someone other than the author review PR #2 and record the outcome in issues #5 and #6.

Note: the ruleset already requires 1 approval, so check how this merge got through without an independent one (for example, the author approved their own PR, or the approval came from the same identity).

This repo is classified as production. You don't need to reply about classification unless you disagree.
